title: ClickToSeeNames
description: Hide all player nametags and reveal names only when right-clicking a player. Supports MiniMessage and displays the nickname above the hotbar.
body:
**СlickToSeeNames** is a lightweight and immersive Minecraft plugin that completely hides player nametags, making player interactions feel more natural and realistic. Instead of always seeing names through walls or from a distance, players must physically approach and right-click someone to reveal their nickname in the ActionBar above the hotbar.

The plugin fully **supports MiniMessage** formatting, allowing server owners to customize the ActionBar message with gradients, HEX colors, rainbow effects, bold text, and more. The displayed nickname can be styled however you want using the %player% placeholder.

### Features:
• Hides all nametags globally
• Reveal player names only on right-click
• ActionBar nickname display
• Full MiniMessage support
• HEX colors, gradients, rainbow formatting, bold text, etc.
• Placeholder support with %player%
• Automatic compatibility with the TAB plugin API
• Vanilla Scoreboard fallback if TAB is not installed
• Lightweight and optimized
• Easy configuration and reload support

### Example configuration:

ActionBar nickname display format

%player% — automatically replaced with the clicked player's name.

Full MiniMessage support (Colors, HEX, Gradients, Rainbow, Bold, etc.)

**actionbar-format:** '<gray>You looked at: <gradient:blue:dark_blue><bold>%player%</bold></gradient>'
